sanskrit: vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayam ekam anantam anādim bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande
l1:
## bh-p01 (1)
pervading-the-particular-states-of-moving-and-unmoving / consisting-of-consciousness / one / endless / beginningless / Bhairava-Lord / of-helpless / by-mind-become-Yours / in-heart / I-venerate // bh-p01
l2: Pervading the particular states of moving and unmoving — consciousness-made, one, endless, beginningless: Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate.

sanskrit: tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam
l1:
## bh-p02 (2)
become-of-You / this / without-remainder / now / appears / to-me / by-power-of-Your-grace / You / Maheśa / always / my / self / my / all // bh-p02
l2: All this, become of You, now appears to me by the power of Your grace. You, Maheśa, are always my self; by You all is mine.

sanskrit: svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhītikathāsti satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu
l1:
## bh-p03 (3)
in-own-self / all-pervading / in-You / as-Lord / therefore / not / of-transmigration-fear-talk / exists / Even-though / hard-to-bear / suffering / delusion / terror / causing / in-karma-hosts // bh-p03
l2: With You as Lord, all-pervading in own self — therefore no talk of transmigration-fear. Even though hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, terror-causing karmas are present, no fear is discussed, yet suffering is not denied.

sanskrit: antaka māṃ prati mā dṛśam enāṃ krodhakarālatamāṃ vinidhehi śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo 'smi
l1:
## bh-p04 (4)
O-Ender / toward-me / toward / not / gaze / this / most-wrathful-terrible / direct / By-Śaṅkara-service / contemplation-firm / I-am / terrifying-Bhairava-power-filled // bh-p04
l2: O Ender, turn not toward me this most wrathful-terrible gaze. Firm in Śaṅkara-service and contemplation, I am filled with terrifying Bhairava-power.

sanskrit: ittham upoḍhabhavanmayasaṃviddīdhitidāritabhūritamisraḥ mṛtyuyamāntakakarmapiśācaiḥ nātha ! namo'stu na jātu bibhemi
l1:
## bh-p05 (5)
thus / whose-great-darkness-is-dispelled-by-rays-of-world-awareness / Death-Yama-ender-karma-ghosts / Lord / salutation / never / I-fear // bh-p05
l2: Thus — my great darkness dispelled by rays of world-awareness: death, Yama, the ender, karma-ghosts — Lord, salutation; never do I fear.

sanskrit: proditasatyavibodhamarīciprekṣitaviśvapadārthasatattvaḥ bhāvaparāmṛtanirbharapūrṇe tvayi aham ātmani nirvṛtim emi
l1:
## bh-p06 (6)
whose-true-essence-of-world-objects-is-seen-by-rays-of-arisen-true-awakening / In-being-full / in-you / I / self / bliss / I-enter // bh-p06
l2: The true essence of world-objects is seen by rays of arisen true awakening. In being-full in You — I, the self, enter bliss.

sanskrit: mānasagocaram eti yadaiva kleśadaśā tanutāpavidhātrī nātha ! tadaiva mama tvadabhedas stotraparāmṛtavṛṣṭiḥ udeti
l1:
## bh-p07 (7)
into-mind's-range / comes / when-indeed / affliction-state / producing-slight-anguish / Lord / then-alone / my / with-you-nondifference / hymn-supreme-nectar-rain / arises // bh-p07
l2: When the affliction-state, producing slight anguish, comes into the mind's range — Lord, then alone is my nondifference with You; the supreme-nectar-rain arises.

sanskrit: śaṅkara satyam idam vratadānasnānatapaḥ bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstra parāmṛtacintā cetasi nirvṛtidhārām syandati
l1:
## bh-p08 (8)
O-Śaṅkara / truly / this / vow-giving-bathing-austerity / dispelling-becoming's-heat / Your-scripture / supreme-nectar-contemplation / in-mind / bliss-stream / flows // bh-p08
l2: Truly, O Śaṅkara: vow, giving, bathing, austerity dispel becoming's heat. Rites relativized, not despised. Contemplation of Your scripture as supreme nectar streams a bliss-stream in mind.

sanskrit: nṛtyati gāyati hṛṣyati gāḍham saṃvit iyam mama bhairavanātha tvāṃ priyam āpya sudarśanamekam durlabhamanyajanaiḥ samayajñam
l1:
## bh-p09 (9)
dances / sings / rejoices / deeply / consciousness / this / my / O-Bhairava-Lord / You / dear / having-obtained / beautiful-vision-alone / hard-to-get-by-others / samaya-knower // bh-p09
l2: This consciousness of mine dances, sings, deeply rejoices — O Bhairava-Lord. Having obtained You, the dear: the beautiful vision alone, hard to get by others, samaya-knower.

sanskrit: vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyām abhinavaguptaḥ stavam imam akarot yena vibhuḥ bhavati janasya arusantāpaṃ śamayati jhaṭiti dayāluḥ
l1:
## bh-p10 (10)
in-the-month-of-Pauṣa / on-the-dark-tenth / Abhinavagupta / hymn / this / made / By-whom / the-Lord / becomes / world's / great-heat / pacifies / instantly / compassionate // bh-p10
l2: In the month of Pauṣa, on the dark tenth, Abhinavagupta made this hymn. The pervasive, compassionate Lord pacifies the world's desert-heat — instantly.
